properties.name: When a proof search changes route, the change is a recorded decision caused by the source or result that forced it, naming the route left and the route taken
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-30 ("Go with your recommendations", option (b) of dec:idea-the-preserved-search-is-a-deliverable-of-working-a-proof-hole)
properties.statement: In the work on a proof hole (increment 5), every change of route is recorded as a Decision drawn CAUSED BY the source or result that forced it, stating what that source changed, the route left and the route taken, so the path's turns and their causes can be inspected afterwards. This is how increment 5 is run; reflow2's existing records (Decision, CAUSES, sources by checksum, stamps) carry it.
